nodes.title: Microsoft Entra identity lifecycle and authentication
Azure resource governance, RBAC, policy, and cost control
Azure Storage account architecture, redundancy, and data movement
Azure Storage access, Blob, Files, and data protection
Azure resource deployment, virtual machines, and resilience
Azure App Service and container compute
Azure virtual networking, addressing, peering, routing, and DNS
Azure network security, private access, and load balancing
Azure Monitor, backup, and Site Recovery operations

crossNodeRelationships: Identity and governance choices constrain every Azure resource administration decision.
Storage, compute, networking, and monitoring nodes own their service decisions while using cross-node context only for operational transfer.
The monitoring and recovery node integrates evidence from every workload without duplicating service-configuration ownership.

blockPlans.title: Identity and directory foundations
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Distinguish tenant, directory, identity, account, object, and principal concepts; compare Microsoft Entra ID with AD DS only where the distinction changes an administrator decision. Avoid broad AZ-900 trivia.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Distinguish tenant, directory, identity, account, object, and principal concepts; compare Microsoft Entra ID with AD DS only where the distinction changes an administrator decision. Avoid broad AZ-900 trivia.

blockPlans.title: User lifecycle and properties
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Author creation, bulk import, property management, disable/delete/restore, and ownership scenarios. Include portal, PowerShell, and CLI state interpretation rather than menu-location recall.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Author creation, bulk import, property management, disable/delete/restore, and ownership scenarios. Include portal, PowerShell, and CLI state interpretation rather than menu-location recall.

blockPlans.title: Group design, membership, and administration
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover security versus Microsoft 365 groups, assigned versus dynamic membership, owners, nested-membership boundaries, and group lifecycle. Distractors should represent realistic group-type or membership-rule mistakes.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover security versus Microsoft 365 groups, assigned versus dynamic membership, owners, nested-membership boundaries, and group lifecycle. Distractors should represent realistic group-type or membership-rule mistakes.

blockPlans.title: License assignment and group-based licensing
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test direct and group-based assignment, inherited license state, conflicting service plans, usage location, and troubleshooting license results. Keep SKU availability facts source-dated.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test direct and group-based assignment, inherited license state, conflicting service plans, usage location, and troubleshooting license results. Keep SKU availability facts source-dated.

blockPlans.title: External identities and B2B lifecycle
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover invitations, redemption, guest object state, sponsors/owners, access boundaries, and remove/reinvite decisions. Distinguish external identity administration from Azure RBAC authorization.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover invitations, redemption, guest object state, sponsors/owners, access boundaries, and remove/reinvite decisions. Distinguish external identity administration from Azure RBAC authorization.

blockPlans.title: Self-service password reset
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test scope, registration, authentication methods, combined registration, administrator versus user behavior, licensing boundaries, and diagnosis of why SSPR is unavailable.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test scope, registration, authentication methods, combined registration, administrator versus user behavior, licensing boundaries, and diagnosis of why SSPR is unavailable.

blockPlans.title: Identity administration with portal, PowerShell, and CLI
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Use short command or output fragments to identify intended operations, object IDs, tenant context, and failed changes. Do not make exact command spelling the primary skill unless the command semantics are the objective.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Use short command or output fragments to identify intended operations, object IDs, tenant context, and failed changes. Do not make exact command spelling the primary skill unless the command semantics are the objective.

blockPlans.title: Integrated identity scenarios and misconception repair
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Combine user, group, license, guest, and SSPR evidence. Focus on effective state, least administrative effort, and boundaries such as Entra roles versus Azure RBAC.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Combine user, group, license, guest, and SSPR evidence. Focus on effective state, least administrative effort, and boundaries such as Entra roles versus Azure RBAC.

blockPlans.title: Management hierarchy, subscriptions, and management groups
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test tenant/root management group/management group/subscription scope, inheritance, subscription placement, and governance design. Include practical hierarchy diagrams and effective-scope questions.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test tenant/root management group/management group/subscription scope, inheritance, subscription placement, and governance design. Include practical hierarchy diagrams and effective-scope questions.

blockPlans.title: Resource groups, resource providers, moves, and limits
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover resource-group lifecycle, provider registration, move prerequisites, dependencies, region versus resource-group scope, and subscription limits. Keep service-specific move limitations source-dated.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover resource-group lifecycle, provider registration, move prerequisites, dependencies, region versus resource-group scope, and subscription limits. Keep service-specific move limitations source-dated.

blockPlans.title: Built-in RBAC role selection
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Train least-privilege selection among Owner, Contributor, Reader, User Access Administrator, and service-specific built-in roles. Use custom roles only as a contrast boundary because the current guide emphasizes built-in roles.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Train least-privilege selection among Owner, Contributor, Reader, User Access Administrator, and service-specific built-in roles. Use custom roles only as a contrast boundary because the current guide emphasizes built-in roles.

blockPlans.title: Role assignments, scopes, inheritance, and effective access
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover security principal, role definition, scope, inheritance, overlapping assignments, deny assignments, conditions where relevant, and interpretation of effective access.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover security principal, role definition, scope, inheritance, overlapping assignments, deny assignments, conditions where relevant, and interpretation of effective access.

blockPlans.title: Azure Policy definitions, effects, assignments, and exclusions
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test policy versus RBAC, definition structure, effects, assignment scope, exclusions, parameters, and evaluation behavior. Prefer compliance and enforcement decisions over definition-name memorization.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test policy versus RBAC, definition structure, effects, assignment scope, exclusions, parameters, and evaluation behavior. Prefer compliance and enforcement decisions over definition-name memorization.

blockPlans.title: Policy initiatives, compliance, and remediation
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover initiatives, compliance states, remediation tasks, managed identities required by modify/deployIfNotExists, exemptions, and diagnosis of noncompliant resources.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover initiatives, compliance states, remediation tasks, managed identities required by modify/deployIfNotExists, exemptions, and diagnosis of noncompliant resources.

blockPlans.title: Tags and resource locks
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Train tag application, inheritance limitations, policy-enforced tags, cost grouping, CanNotDelete versus ReadOnly, lock inheritance, and operations blocked by locks.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Train tag application, inheritance limitations, policy-enforced tags, cost grouping, CanNotDelete versus ReadOnly, lock inheritance, and operations blocked by locks.

blockPlans.title: Cost Management, budgets, alerts, and Advisor
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover cost analysis scopes, budgets and forecast alerts, action behavior, cost allocation by tags, and when Azure Advisor cost recommendations are relevant. Avoid volatile price trivia.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover cost analysis scopes, budgets and forecast alerts, action behavior, cost allocation by tags, and when Azure Advisor cost recommendations are relevant. Avoid volatile price trivia.

blockPlans.title: Integrated governance and effective-state scenarios
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Combine hierarchy, RBAC, Policy, locks, tags, and cost controls in multi-resource scenarios. Include Activity Log evidence and portal/CLI/PowerShell outputs while keeping the target skill on governance decisions.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Combine hierarchy, RBAC, Policy, locks, tags, and cost controls in multi-resource scenarios. Include Activity Log evidence and portal/CLI/PowerShell outputs while keeping the target skill on governance decisions.

blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test account-kind and performance decisions, supported services, hierarchical namespace boundaries, endpoints, regions, and creation constraints. Avoid obsolete account types except as explicit migration distractors.

blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover LRS, ZRS, GRS, RA-GRS, GZRS, and RA-GZRS trade-offs; region and zone failure scenarios; read access; durability versus availability; and service support boundaries.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover LRS, ZRS, GRS, RA-GRS, GZRS, and RA-GZRS trade-offs; region and zone failure scenarios; read access; durability versus availability; and service support boundaries.

blockPlans.authoringBrief: Train replication lag, account failover consequences, DNS endpoint behavior, last-sync-time interpretation, and recovery choices. Keep current service limitations source-dated.

blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test encryption at rest, Microsoft-managed versus customer-managed keys, key vault access, key rotation, infrastructure encryption, and failure states caused by inaccessible keys.

blockPlans.authoringBrief: Use copy/sync scenarios, source and destination authorization, recursive filters, overwrite behavior, resume/log evidence, and tool selection. Avoid command trivia without operational meaning.

blockPlans.authoringBrief: Train local/global peering, non-transitivity, forwarded traffic, gateway transit/use-remote-gateways, overlapping ranges, DNS considerations, and interpreting disconnected or ineffective peerings.

blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover system routes, UDRs, longest-prefix match, route source precedence, next-hop types, BGP propagation, association, and effective-route interpretation.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover system routes, UDRs, longest-prefix match, route source precedence, next-hop types, BGP propagation, association, and effective-route interpretation.

blockPlans.title: Hub-spoke, network virtual appliances, and intersite boundaries
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Use hub-spoke, service chaining, and NVA scenarios; include VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Virtual WAN only as adjacent selection boundaries because they are course content but not current primary objective bullets.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Use hub-spoke, service chaining, and NVA scenarios; include VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Virtual WAN only as adjacent selection boundaries because they are course content but not current primary objective bullets.

blockPlans.title: Azure DNS public zones and delegation
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test zone creation, delegation, record sets, TTL, alias records, custom domains, and troubleshooting delegation or record mistakes.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test zone creation, delegation, record sets, TTL, alias records, custom domains, and troubleshooting delegation or record mistakes.

blockPlans.title: Private DNS and Azure name resolution
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover private zones, virtual-network links, auto-registration, split-horizon scenarios, custom DNS servers, forwarding, and private-endpoint name resolution.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover private zones, virtual-network links, auto-registration, split-horizon scenarios, custom DNS servers, forwarding, and private-endpoint name resolution.

blockPlans.title: Connectivity, route, and DNS troubleshooting
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Combine effective routes, Network Watcher connection troubleshoot/IP flow evidence, NSG dependencies, peering state, DNS resolution, and packet-path reasoning without duplicating the monitoring node.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Combine effective routes, Network Watcher connection troubleshoot/IP flow evidence, NSG dependencies, peering state, DNS resolution, and packet-path reasoning without duplicating the monitoring node.

blockPlans.title: Network security group rule model
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test direction, priority, stateful behavior, protocols/ports, service tags, default rules, augmented rules, and least-privilege rule design.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test direction, priority, stateful behavior, protocols/ports, service tags, default rules, augmented rules, and least-privilege rule design.

blockPlans.title: NSG association, effective rules, and application security groups
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover subnet/NIC association, combined effective rules, ASG membership, conflicting rules, flow diagnosis, and why changing one NSG may not restore connectivity.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover subnet/NIC association, combined effective rules, ASG membership, conflicting rules, flow diagnosis, and why changing one NSG may not restore connectivity.

blockPlans.title: Azure Bastion secure administration
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test deployment requirements, AzureBastionSubnet, public-IP/SKU boundaries, access flow, native client/file-transfer capabilities only when source-current, and contrast with exposing RDP/SSH.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test deployment requirements, AzureBastionSubnet, public-IP/SKU boundaries, access flow, native client/file-transfer capabilities only when source-current, and contrast with exposing RDP/SSH.

blockPlans.title: Virtual network service endpoints
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover route changes, service firewall rules, subnet scope, service endpoint policies, regional/service limitations, and the fact that the service still uses a public endpoint.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover route changes, service firewall rules, subnet scope, service endpoint policies, regional/service limitations, and the fact that the service still uses a public endpoint.

blockPlans.title: Private endpoints and Private Link
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test private-endpoint NICs, approval states, subresources, private DNS, network policies, routing, on-premises resolution, and diagnosis of access still using the public endpoint.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test private-endpoint NICs, approval states, subresources, private DNS, network policies, routing, on-premises resolution, and diagnosis of access still using the public endpoint.

blockPlans.title: Service endpoint, private endpoint, and VNet integration contrasts
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Use precise inbound/outbound and routing requirements to distinguish these mechanisms. Include Storage/App Service examples without turning the block into duplicate service-specific content.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Use precise inbound/outbound and routing requirements to distinguish these mechanisms. Include Storage/App Service examples without turning the block into duplicate service-specific content.

blockPlans.title: Azure Load Balancer design and configuration
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover public/internal load balancers, SKU, frontend/backend pools, probes, load-balancing and inbound NAT rules, HA ports, floating IP, session persistence, and zone considerations.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover public/internal load balancers, SKU, frontend/backend pools, probes, load-balancing and inbound NAT rules, HA ports, floating IP, session persistence, and zone considerations.

blockPlans.title: Load-balancing troubleshooting and adjacent traffic services
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Diagnose unhealthy probes, NSGs/UDRs, backend configuration, SNAT, and rule conflicts. Contrast Application Gateway, Traffic Manager, Front Door, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway only where needed to reject the wrong service.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Diagnose unhealthy probes, NSGs/UDRs, backend configuration, SNAT, and rule conflicts. Contrast Application Gateway, Traffic Manager, Front Door, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway only where needed to reject the wrong service.

blockPlans.title: Azure Monitor data sources and data model
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Distinguish metrics, Activity Log, resource logs, guest logs/metrics, platform versus application data, scopes, latency/retention, and which signal can answer a scenario.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Distinguish metrics, Activity Log, resource logs, guest logs/metrics, platform versus application data, scopes, latency/retention, and which signal can answer a scenario.

blockPlans.title: Diagnostic settings, workspaces, agents, and data collection rules
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover diagnostic settings destinations, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, data collection rules/endpoints, table routing, retention, and troubleshooting missing telemetry.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover diagnostic settings destinations, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, data collection rules/endpoints, table routing, retention, and troubleshooting missing telemetry.

blockPlans.title: Metrics analysis and Azure Monitor Insights
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test metrics explorer, aggregation, dimensions, time grain, baselines, VM insights, storage insights, network insights, workbooks, and interpretation of contradictory signals.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test metrics explorer, aggregation, dimensions, time grain, baselines, VM insights, storage insights, network insights, workbooks, and interpretation of contradictory signals.

blockPlans.title: Query and analyze logs with KQL
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Use concise KQL fragments and outputs to test table choice, time filters, where/project/extend/summarize/order, basic joins at exam depth, and diagnosis of empty or misleading results.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Use concise KQL fragments and outputs to test table choice, time filters, where/project/extend/summarize/order, basic joins at exam depth, and diagnosis of empty or misleading results.

blockPlans.title: Alert rules, action groups, and alert processing rules
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover metric/log/activity alerts, scope, condition, frequency/window, severity, action groups, common alert schema, suppression/routing with processing rules, and failed-notification diagnosis.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover metric/log/activity alerts, scope, condition, frequency/window, severity, action groups, common alert schema, suppression/routing with processing rules, and failed-notification diagnosis.

blockPlans.title: Network Watcher and Connection Monitor
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Test connection troubleshoot, IP flow verify, next-hop/effective rules, topology, packet capture/NSG flow capabilities at exam depth, Connection Monitor, and evidence-based fault isolation.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Test connection troubleshoot, IP flow verify, next-hop/effective rules, topology, packet capture/NSG flow capabilities at exam depth, Connection Monitor, and evidence-based fault isolation.

blockPlans.title: Backup vault selection and policy design
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Distinguish Recovery Services vault and Backup vault by supported workload, region/subscription constraints, redundancy, soft delete/immutability where current, policy schedule/retention, and protection prerequisites.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Distinguish Recovery Services vault and Backup vault by supported workload, region/subscription constraints, redundancy, soft delete/immutability where current, policy schedule/retention, and protection prerequisites.

blockPlans.title: Backup, restore, monitoring, reports, and alerts
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover enable/disable protection, on-demand backup, restore options, instant restore/snapshots, cross-region restore boundaries, soft delete, job monitoring, Backup Reports, alerts, and troubleshooting failed jobs.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover enable/disable protection, on-demand backup, restore options, instant restore/snapshots, cross-region restore boundaries, soft delete, job monitoring, Backup Reports, alerts, and troubleshooting failed jobs.

blockPlans.title: Azure Site Recovery replication and failover lifecycle
blockPlans.primaryMentalModel: Cover source/target preparation, replication settings, recovery plans, test/planned/unplanned failover, commit, reprotect/failback, secondary-region failover, monitoring, and integrated DR decision scenarios.
blockPlans.authoringBrief: Cover source/target preparation, replication settings, recovery plans, test/planned/unplanned failover, commit, reprotect/failback, secondary-region failover, monitoring, and integrated DR decision scenarios.
